messages:
alex: Quick sync — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421 needs a docs pass. Changes touch batching examples, cache prefetch doc, and the quant profiles table. Also one SDK snippet link 404. Need a quick owner for link fix + a short migration note. cc @jia @maria
jia: I opened the PR yesterday; I updated Go and JS SDK snippets to show `batchSize` and `kv_prefetch` flags. The JS snippet link to the CDN example is 404, looks like the js examples repo moved. I'll remove the CDN until we have a stable path. @maria can you confirm accuracy for the Go snippet?
maria: On it. Quick glance: Go example uses `PrefetchPolicy{Enabled: true}` which we renamed to `KVPrefetch: true` in the client lib last month. I'll push a tiny commit to update and add a one-line note in migration guide.
patrick: Flag: the quant profiles table now lists `q4_0` and `q4_1` but the recommendation column is a bit confusing — it says 'use q4_1 for short sequences' while our bench shows q4_0 has slightly better perf at seq<64. Can we change wording to 'prefer q4_0 for short sequences (seq<64), q4_1 for mixed-length' and add a link to the benchmark CSV?
ken: I can add the CSV link. Where should it live? docs/perf/benchmarks/ ?
alex: Yes ken, drop it under docs/perf/ and update the README with a short summary. Also let's not add new large binaries to the repo — just the CSV and a small README.
jia: I'll remove the CDN link and point to the new CSV once ken uploads. Also adding a tiny migration snippet: `client.Config.KVPrefetch = true` -> `client.Config.KVPrefetch = v1.PrefetchAuto`? wait which API did we land on?
maria: We standardized on enums: `KVPrefetchModeAuto` / `KVPrefetchModeOn` / `KVPrefetchModeOff`. Use `KVPrefetchModeAuto` in the example.
patrick: :thumbsup: I'll update the quant table wording and add a footnote referencing the CSV and a small plot. Can we also clarify the latency column units (ms vs s) — current table is ambiguous.
ken: Uploaded CSV to docs/perf/2026-03-batch-kv-bench.csv and added README.md with notes and a small chart link: https://perfstorage.redwood/infer/2026/03/plots.html
deploy-bot: auto-link-checker: found 1 broken link in PR 421 -> removed or updated by jia. Re-run required.
alex: Great work — @maria @patrick can you both review the final PR after jia pushes the CDN removal + link updates? Aim to merge today if no major issues. Thanks!
